note: A reminder to book a time, not a reminder of a booked one, so it stays scheduling. The booked reminder pattern has to step around it. The envelope is modeled on one from the Jev trial (a trial write-up, not kept in the repository because it quoted the person's own data), with the company, names and addresses changed. The body was not fetched: Gmail was not reachable from the session that wrote this, and the ledger never stores one, so the fixture holds only what the rules read from the envelope.
